extracted.name: Quick Chicken Divan
extracted.description: This chicken Divan recipe with mayo features layers of broccoli and chopped chicken cooked in a creamy canned soup sauce with cheese in under one hour.
ingredient_lines: 2 cooked boneless chicken breast halves, chopped
1 (10.75 ounce) can condensed cream of chicken soup
1 (10.75 ounce) can condensed cream of mushroom soup
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Spread broccoli in the bottom of a 9x13-inch baking dish. Top with chicken.
Stir together condensed soups, mayonnaise, and lemon juice in a medium bowl until well combined; pour over chicken. Sprinkle with Cheddar cheese.
Bake in the preheated oven until bubbly and lightly browned, 35 to 40 minutes.
